input.goal: Chop carrot, coriander and avocado and add to bowl with tabbouleh salad.

sub_goals.text: Chop the carrot and add it to the salad bowl.
Measure, chop, and add coriander to the salad bowl.
Scoop the avocado pieces, measure them, and add to the salad bowl.

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment

plan.goal: Chop carrot, coriander and avocado and add to bowl with tabbouleh salad.

events.description: The carrot is placed on the scale to be measured.
events.relevance: Measures the correct amount of carrot for the salad.

events.description: The carrot is peeled using a peeler.
A scraping sound is heard as the peeler removes the carrot skin.
events.relevance: Indicates the peeling action is occurring.

events.description: The peeled carrot is chopped into pieces with a knife on a cutting board.
events.relevance: Processes the carrot into the required size for the salad.

events.description: Rhythmic chopping sounds are heard as the knife hits the cutting board.
events.relevance: Indicates the chopping action is actively happening.

events.description: The chopped carrot pieces are transferred into the salad bowl.
events.relevance: Combines the prepared carrot with the rest of the salad.

events.description: Coriander is placed on the scale to be measured.
events.relevance: Ensures the correct amount of coriander is used.

events.description: The coriander is chopped with a knife.
events.relevance: Prepares the herb for the salad.

events.description: The chopped coriander is added to the salad bowl.
events.relevance: Integrates the coriander into the salad mixture.

events.description: The avocado is cut in half using a knife.
events.relevance: Opens the avocado to access the flesh.

events.description: The flesh of the avocado half is scored in a grid pattern with the knife.
events.relevance: Pre-cuts the avocado flesh into pieces for easy scooping.

events.description: The scored avocado pieces are scooped out of the skin using a spoon.
events.relevance: Removes the edible avocado pieces from the skin.

events.description: The scooped avocado pieces are placed on the scale to be measured.
events.relevance: Ensures the correct quantity of avocado is added.

events.description: The measured avocado pieces are transferred into the salad bowl.
events.relevance: Completes the addition of all required ingredients to the salad.

relations.ask: What is the state of the carrot when it is being chopped?
relations.answer_hint: The carrot was peeled in the previous step.

relations.ask: What is already in the salad bowl when the coriander is added?
relations.answer_hint: The chopped carrot was added to the bowl in the previous step.

relations.ask: What does the salad bowl contain while the avocado is being cut?
relations.answer_hint: The chopped carrot and coriander were added to it in the preceding steps.

relations.ask: Why does the avocado flesh come out in small pieces when scooped?
relations.answer_hint: It was scored into a grid pattern with a knife in the previous step.

relations.ask: How does the state of the avocado flesh change during the scooping action?
relations.answer_hint: It goes from being scored inside the skin to loose pieces.

decision_points.why: Transitioning from peeling and measuring to chopping requires a change of tools (peeler to knife) and a new physical action.
The person must decide to switch from preparing the carrot to preparing a new ingredient, the coriander.
The person must decide to switch from preparing the coriander to preparing the avocado.
Transitioning from scoring the avocado to scooping it requires switching tools from a knife to a spoon.
All specified ingredients have been chopped and added to the bowl, meaning the person must decide that the task is complete.
